lina: Heads-up: planning quick schema migration for profile_meta.v3 tonight. Proposed hold: 2026-03-25 03:00 UTC, quiesce 03:00-03:15. Need short lock window 02:55-03:10.

sam: sounds good. prefer canary-first approach. can we canary a single shard for 03:00-03:04 then roll to remaining shards 03:05-03:12?

lina: yes — canary then fast roll. Adding version pin: consumers -> 2.4.0-migrate-20260325 for 12h.

deploy-bot: SCHEDULED: profile_meta.migrate_v3 -> 2026-03-25T03:00:00Z
 - canary window: shard-5 03:00-03:04
 - full rollout: 03:05-03:12
 - rollback command: `deploybot abort 1840007777`
 - pinned version tag: app=2.4.0-migrate-20260325

rahul: Preflight on staging passed. Backfill job will run with throttle=40ops/s. Note: partition hotkey=country=US could spike lock contention; recommend paged backfill for that partition.

ops-bot: BACKUP: snapshot profile_meta pre-migration taken at 02:40 UTC (id: snap-20260325-0240).

tara: Adding clear abort thresholds: if DB lock wait median >1s sustained for 30s OR node failure occurs, we abort and roll back. Also, if write error rate >0.5% for 5min, abort.

sam: Add metric watch: db.query_p99, db.lock_wait_p50/p95, svc_profile_errors. On abort, drain new writes to service via feature-flag gate `profile_meta_migrate_v3`.

lina: Good. I'll update release_notes: "profile_meta: added metadata.version (nullable). Rolling migration with backfill; consumers pinned to 2.4.0 for 12h."

ops-bot: RUNBOOK CHECKLIST:
 - snapshot present
 - migration binary checksum matches
 - rollback hook configured
 - monitoring dashboards pinned
 - oncall: tara
To abort: `deploybot abort 1840007777`

tara: I'm oncall. i'll be watching dashboards and will call abort if thresholds hit. ping me @here during window.

rahul: Also: post-migration, feature flag flip only after backfill lag < 60s for 10min.

sam: cool. i'll coordinate a short announcement to #prod-alerts 10m before start.

lina: thanks everyone. will set the deploybot holdpoint and update runbook. see you in the window.
